subject: health
unitTitle: Nutrition, Movement, Sleep, and Performance Without Diet Culture
title: Application or project: recovery
essentialQuestion: How can understanding nutrition, movement, sleep, and performance without diet culture help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?
materials: unit-specific source, model, manipulatives, safe materials, or approved digital tool
keyPoints: Recovery is an active part of training and daily life; rest, sleep, food, fluids, and gradual return reduce the chance that ordinary fatigue becomes injury or illness.
Compare care options by function, access, safety, and sustainability; avoid appearance rules, shame, rigid perfection, or assumptions about another person’s habits.

knowledgeCheck: In two or three sentences, explain the most important distinction in recovery; use one lesson fact and name the evidence, safety check, or support route that makes the explanation dependable.
